prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: the best places in the Pleasanton area to buy tires are usually Costco Tire Center (Pleasanton) and Discount Tire (nearest location in Dublin), and for installation quality independent/ASE shops or chain shops such as Firestone Complete Auto Care are solid choices. Which is “best” depends on your priorities (price, warranty, service, same‑day install, alignment).

If you want a quick recommendation by priority
- Best price + warranty if you’re a member: Costco Tire Center (Pleasanton) — competitive tire pricing, mounting, balancing, lifetime rotations and balancing for members, and decent warranty handling.
- Best customer service & installation experience: Discount Tire (nearest in Dublin) — known for fast appointments, good installs, and mobile service in some cases.
- Good full‑service option (tires + alignment + repairs): Firestone Complete Auto Care or a well‑rated local independent shop — better if you want a one‑stop shop and more personalized service.

What to check when choosing a seller/installer
- Total out‑the‑door price: tires + mounting + valve stems + balancing + disposal fees + taxes.
- Road hazard or free replacement warranty (important for cost over time).
- Lifetime rotation/balancing and nitrogen (if you care).
- Whether they include alignment or offer a discounted alignment after new tires.
- Turnaround time (same day?) and whether you need an appointment.
- Reviews on Google/Yelp for recent installation quality and customer service.
- TPMS service and whether they charge for new sensors or reprogramming.

Questions to ask when you call or book
- “What’s the total price for these tires (include mount/balance, new valves, disposal)?”
- “Do you include a road‑hazard or replacement warranty?”
- “Do you recommend/requiring an alignment after installation, and is there a package price?”
- “How long will installation take and do you require an appointment?”
- “What paperwork/warranty do you provide if there’s an issue later?”

If you want, tell me:
- your vehicle (make/model/year), tire size (or what’s on the sidewall), and budget,
- whether you have a Costco membership,
and I’ll give a targeted shortlist of exact shops to call in Pleasanton/Dublin/Livermore and a sample script to get the best deal.
